payout_quote: Public Bug Bounty programs are open to our entire community of ethical hackers and their basic details are publicly disclosed.
steps: Create a free YesWeHack hunter account.
Browse public bug bounty programs (basic details publicly disclosed).
Read each program's rules of engagement and scope.
Test in-scope assets and submit validated findings.
YesWeHack's triage validates each bug; hunters earn monetary rewards tiered by severity for validated findings.
catches: Only validated, in-scope findings are rewarded — duplicates earn nothing.
Bounty amounts are set per program and tiered by severity; no platform-wide range.
Private programs are restricted to handpicked, vetted, high-ranking hunters.
Requires real security skills; beginners earn nothing for a long time.
biggest_catch: Payment requires validated in-scope findings — most testing time produces no payout, and private programs are invite-only.
eligibility: Free hunter account; public programs open to the whole community.
timing: Programs run continuously; rewards per program terms after validation.
